_comment: METARA logo database. Layer 0 = universal marks used regardless of venture. Layer 1 = category families (Nonprofit, Commercial, Social Enterprise, Cooperative). Layer 2 = individual venture marks nested under a family. Update this file whenever a logo is added, renamed, or reassigned.

logos.name: Cosmic Egg (hero emblem)
logos.description: Hero emblem: core mark + Merkaba (two interlocking tetrahedra, shaded) + orbiting Platonic solids ring (synchronized radial-axis rotation, 24 precomputed keyframes/solid) + arced METARA wordmark (live text, Philosopher font).
logos.notes: Rotation frame data lives in the inline <script> at the end of index.html. No runtime geometry computation -- all keyframes precomputed. Updated 2026-08 (second pass): the halo/atom/seed-of-life/merkaba/mark portion of the hero SVG was replaced wholesale with the actual content of 'logo for website/Cosmic Egg/merkaba-shaded-behind-mark.svg' (the real designer source, superseding an earlier hand-approximated gradient version). SVG ids namespaced with an 'egg-' prefix. The Platonic-solids ring group (ids solid-tetra/cube/octa/dodeca/icosa, used by the rotation JS) was left untouched, as confirmed unchanged by Phiji. The arc-text font-size was bumped from 19 to 21 to reflect Phiji's 'slightly larger' adjustment -- the reference SVG doesn't contain the arc text itself (it's added live via CSS/textPath, same as before), so this value is an estimate; flag if it needs fine-tuning.
